title: Not Very Useful For Me
text: Not Very Useful For Me. Just wasn't for me. I'm sure there's people this could help but I need to keep my heels off the bed and this was so narrow it left my knees in the air arching backwards which was extremely painful. I tried for five days to break it in as a head pillow. I do like my pillows narrow but it was hard and I'm guessing older style memory foam because it held the heat like crazy and being half round it wasn't possible to flip this to 'the cool side' and have it still be comfortable. This was unusable for me. Three stars because it may be useful to others and the company handled the refund flawlessly. I do like people who back their products 100%.
